# pve_ceph_mon (Data Source)

Reads a single Ceph monitor from `GET /nodes/{node}/ceph/mon`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_ceph_mon" "pve1" {
  node  = "pve1"
  monid = "pve1"
}

output "mon_state" {
  value = data.pve_ceph_mon.pve1.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monid` (String) Monitor ID (typically the hostname).
- `node` (String) Name of the PVE node the listing request is issued against.

### Read-Only

- `addr` (String) Ceph-formatted monitor address as advertised by the monitor (typically `IP:PORT/NONCE`, possibly a messenger-v2 vector).
- `ceph_version` (String) Full Ceph version string of the monitor daemon.
- `ceph_version_short` (String) Short Ceph version string of the monitor daemon (e.g. `19.2.0`).
- `dir_exists` (Boolean) Whether the monitor's data directory exists on this node.
- `host` (String) Host the monitor runs on.
- `id` (String) Identifier in the form `<node>:<monid>`.
- `in_quorum` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is part of the current quorum.
- `rank` (Number) Rank of the monitor within the mon map.
- `service` (Boolean) Whether a `ceph-mon@<id>` systemd unit is enabled on the hosting node.
- `state` (String) Run state of the monitor: `running` (in quorum), `stopped` (systemd unit configured but daemon not visible to the cluster), or `unknown` (no rados access).
